article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques
trigger_conditions: subliminal techniques beyond a person's consciousness or purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques
objective or effect of materially distorting behaviour
appreciably impairs ability to make an informed decision
causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Exploitation of vulnerabilities
trigger_conditions: exploits vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or social/economic situation
objective or effect of materially distorting behaviour
causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Social scoring leading to detrimental treatment
contexts: evaluation or classification over a period of time
trigger_conditions: evaluation or classification based on social behaviour or known, inferred or predicted personal/personality characteristics
social score leads to detrimental or unfavourable treatment
treatment is unrelated, unjustified, or disproportionate

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Criminal offence risk assessment based solely on profiling
trigger_conditions: AI system assesses or predicts risk of a natural person committing a criminal offence
based solely on profiling or personality traits and characteristics
exceptions: AI systems used to support human assessment of involvement in criminal activity based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to criminal activity
safeguards: objective and verifiable facts directly linked to criminal activity

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Untargeted scraping for facial recognition databases
trigger_conditions: AI system creates or expands facial recognition databases
untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Emotion recognition in workplace or education
trigger_conditions: AI system infers emotions of a natural person
use occurs in workplace or education institutions

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Biometric categorisation to infer sensitive traits
trigger_conditions: categorises individually natural persons based on biometric data
deduces or infers sensitive traits listed in Article 5(1)(g)
exceptions: labelling or filtering of lawfully acquired biometric datasets based on biometric data
categorising biometric data in law enforcement

article_5_prohibited_practices.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement
targets: natural persons in publicly accessible spaces
trigger_conditions: use of real-time remote biometric identification systems
publicly accessible spaces
law enforcement purpose
exceptions: targeted search for specific victims of abduction, trafficking in human beings or sexual exploitation, and missing persons
prevention of a specific, substantial and imminent threat to life or physical safety or a terrorist attack
localisation or identification of a person suspected of listed serious criminal offences punishable by at least four years
safeguards: prior authorisation by judicial or independent administrative authority
notification to market surveillance and data protection authorities
